name: Elul
overview: The month of Elul holds significant biblical importance as the time when the Jews completed the wall of Jerusalem, accomplishing this feat in just fifty-two days as recorded in Nehemiah 6:15. This period also coincides with the rebuilding efforts led by Zerubbabel, who, along with Joshua the high priest and the remnant of the people, was stirred by the LORD to work on the temple, beginning on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month as noted in Haggai 1:14-15. These events highlight God's providential hand in restoring both the physical and spiritual foundations of His people during this pivotal time.
